verdict.rationale: Deel describes an in-platform workflow where businesses and workers complete forms, submit required documents, pay fees and track status, with the US visa journey 'fully digital' from intake forms to application tracking. The assessment also returns document requirements, which works as a rough checklist. However, the only reminders evidenced are visa-expiry and renewal alerts, not prompts for outstanding evidence, and the upload capability rests on a single glossary line. Missing for 10: an explicit per-case document checklist, automated reminders for missing documents, documentation of how upload and review works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
